# Trimmed from a real /public_metrics reading of redpandadata/redpanda:v24.2.18, captured on
# 2026-08-08 while TestRouterConsumeCeiling held its window, with:
#
#	docker port <container> 9644
#	curl -s http://127.0.0.1:<port>/public_metrics
#
# Captured UNDER LOAD on purpose: on an idle broker every histogram is zero, and a parser test against
# it cannot tell "parsed correctly" from "parsed nothing at all".
#
# Trimmed, not synthesised: the full reading is 1495 lines and each histogram carries 19 buckets. The
# values below are verbatim; only whole buckets in the middle of each histogram were dropped, so the
# cumulative counts still rise and still end at the family's own _count.
#
# TWO ADDITIONS are not from the capture, and are marked where they appear: a second shard (this
# broker was allocated one core, so nothing here would exercise shard aggregation) and a NaN. Every
# other line is as the broker served it.
